== Notes ==
* This skill is useful for maintaining [[Critical Defenses]] or [[Critical Agility]] since it's a guaranteed critical hit.
* This skill is effective for maintaining your energy because, in addition to restoring energy itself, the critical hits also restore energy with [[Critical Strikes]]. The following table shows the total energy gain (excluding skill cost):
